title: Reverse a Linked List
problem_summary: Reverse the direction of a linked list.

brute_force.idea: Use recursion to reverse each node

optimized.idea: Iterate through the list with three pointers: prev, curr, next

hints: What direction are the pointers currently pointing?
How can you reverse a pointer's direction?
You need to keep track of the previous node. Why?
Once you reverse a pointer, where is the next node?
Three pointers strategy: prev, curr, next will help you manage the reversal.
